Welcome to another competition in Barbados! 🇧🇧 Cubers of all ages and skill levels are encouraged to sign up.

This competition serves as the **2027 National Championship for Barbados**. Competitors of all nationalities are welcome to participate; however, only competitors who are nationals of Barbados are eligible to receive prizes.
